PRESS · THAO VY LAM

Hi, I’m Thao Vy

Over nearly four years at HCM City Law Newspaper (PLO), I have published more than 7,000 articles on international affairs and international law, turning geopolitical conflicts, diplomacy and economic policy into clear, accurate stories for Vietnamese readers.

Beyond reporting, I have taken on editorial work: selecting topics, sourcing ambassadors, consuls general and legal scholars, editing reporters’ questions and expert videos before publication, coordinating media for a national conference, and training student journalists. I now want to bring this experience to an international news desk: shaping coverage, working with reporters and experts, and keeping international reporting rigorous, timely and accessible.

What I bring to an international desk

Planning & sourcing

  • Developed topics and led interviews with ambassadors, consuls general and scholars for the 50-year Vietnam and 30-year ASEAN series.
  • Built a network of experts in law, international relations and economics across universities and research institutions.

Editing & quality control

  • As content editor for in-studio expert interviews: invited the experts, selected topics, edited reporters’ questions and edited the video before publication.
  • Managed embargoed press kits and condensed hours of panel debate into concise analysis under deadline at the UNCLOS conference.

Range across world affairs

  • Covered US tariffs, the US and Israel strikes on Iran, the US attack on Venezuela, the Thailand–Cambodia border tension, Russia–Ukraine and Israel–Hamas.
  • Reported through an international-law and diplomatic lens, including high-level visits and the Shangri-La Dialogue.

Team & audience

  • Trained participants in international news reporting, news writing and translation–interpretation (THE PRESSENDER 2026) and mentored International Relations students.
  • Published across text, video and social formats: 7,000+ articles in nearly four years.
